m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You have returned to me with the four cursed Flameingo feathers. Thank you, young Wizard.
It is no compliment to call a creature brave unless it also knows fear in its heart.
Wizard, I have heard you are courageous. But are you brave enough to break the curse on four warriors branded as cowards?
Jata Brokenspear, a Thornpaw Hunter; Nathi Yellowstripe, an Iklaw Warrior...
...Amedras Lightstep, a disgraced Darajani Guard; and Bolu Bigfist, a Blackback Soldier.
They all fled from battle at one time or another. For their cowardice they were each burdened with a cursed Flameingo feather.
The curse traps them, unable to leave their prisons, until they can stand tall against a true foe. Will you break their curse?
Go and fight each warrior: you will find Jata Brokenspear in the Savannah; Nathi Yellowstripe in the Zamunda Outskirts...
...Amedras Lightstep in Stone Town; and Bolu Bigfist in the Drum Jungle. Bring the cursed Flameingo feathers to me!
Find Jata Brokenspear in the Savannah; Nathi Yellowstone in the Outskirts of Zamunda; Amedras Lightstep in Stone Town...
...and Bolu Bigfist in the Drum Jungle. Restore their courage and bring me their Flameingo feathers!
